title: The Ember of Caerlum
author: Freya Thackeray
blurb: Kestrel Nystrom, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
